en.title: Hunger Games Prequel Dominates Thanksgiving Box Office, Devouring $85M
en.summary: The latest installment in the dystopian franchise, **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping**, is projected to rake in an impressive $85 million over the Thanksgiving holiday weekend. This strong performance solidifies its position at the top of the box office, fending off new releases.
en.body:
The odds, it seems, are ever in **Lionsgate**'s favor. **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** is poised to once again claim the box office crown, with projections estimating a robust $85 million haul over the Thanksgiving weekend. This impressive figure comes after a stellar opening week that saw the film achieve record-breaking numbers for its debut Monday and Tuesday within the beloved dystopian franchise.

Screening in 4,018 North American theaters, **Sunrise on the Reaping** is not just holding its own; it's dominating. The film's estimated five-day Thanksgiving weekend total is expected to push its domestic gross to approximately $233 million. This success story is particularly noteworthy as it navigates its sophomore frame, a period where many films see a significant drop-off. The film, directed by **Francis Lawrence**, delves into the backstory of **Haymitch Abernathy**, portrayed by **Joseph Zada**, a character fans know intimately from **Woody Harrelson**'s iconic performances.

## A Franchise That Refuses to Fade

The **Hunger Games** universe has consistently proven its ability to resonate with audiences, generation after generation. **Sunrise on the Reaping**'s continued box office dominance underscores the franchise's remarkable longevity and its capacity to attract both long-time fans and new viewers. The success of this prequel, which adapts author **Suzanne Collins**' 2025 novel, highlights the enduring power of its core themes and compelling narrative structure. It’s a testament to the world-building that began with the original **Jennifer Lawrence**-led films and has continued to expand with each new entry.

## Facing New Competition

While **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** is clearly the frontrunner, it's not without competition. The Thanksgiving weekend also saw the release of new films like **Focker-in-Law** and **Hexed**. However, early projections and the film's current momentum suggest that these newcomers will struggle to dethrone the reigning champion. The ability of **Sunrise on the Reaping** to maintain such strong audience engagement, even against fresh releases, speaks volumes about the franchise's dedicated fanbase and its ability to generate consistent buzz.

## What's Next

With its Thanksgiving weekend performance expected to solidify its box office standing, all eyes will be on **Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping** to see how it performs in the weeks to come. Further international box office figures will also be crucial in assessing the film's overall global impact.

content_raw: Lionsgate's sixth film in its dystopian franchise looks to win its sophomore frame after notching series records with its debut Monday and Tuesday.
